name: Clofibrate

own_problems.text: Pulled from the market in Israel and 2 other countries, first in 1979 — for blood vessel problems and cancer risk

similar.name: Beclobrate
problems: Pulled from the market in Switzerland, first in 1990 — for liver harm

similar.name: Cloforex
problems: Pulled from the market in Germany and Sweden, first in 1969 — for breathing problems and heart harm

similar.name: Chlorphentermine

summary: Clofibrate was pulled from the market in Israel and two other countries starting in 1979 due to blood vessel issues and cancer risks [3]. A small computer model, not tests on humans, gave Clofibrate low risk scores for heart and liver harm [M]. Other medications similar to Clofibrate were also taken off the market in several countries for harms involving the liver, heart, and breathing [3].
